statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail has eased from the opening downside extension because NDX rebounded roughly 72 points from a fresh session low; the index remains below the open and in the lower part of the range, so renewed extension remains a checkpoint.
recommendation: Current Tail is 23%. The mapped policy state is WATCH; residual downside-path risk is concentrated through 15:30 UTC and would rise only if the rebound fails and another lower-range extension develops.
headline: Tail eases to WATCH as NDX rebounds from a fresh intraday low
body: NDX was 29,473.10 at 10:28:56 ET, down 0.24%, after setting a 29,400.70 session low from a 29,645.18 open. The rebound of roughly 72 points from the low shows meaningful repair. VIX near 15.48 and crude below earlier highs reduce cross-asset alignment, while Middle East escalation keeps Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 32% while Stress was 100%. The prior 14:00 UTC slot reached 32% on cash-open downside extension; earlier elevations repeatedly reverted toward WATCH or low Tail when meaningful repair appeared.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 23% after a meaningful rebound from a fresh intraday low. The residual opening-risk window runs through 15:30 UTC; the base case then trends toward low Tail if two-sided repair persists. Consumer Credit at 19:00 UTC is a WATCH checkpoint, while Employer Costs at 14:00 UTC on September 9 is the next scheduled U.S. data checkpoint.
